facts.text: Marshall University's Metro tuition covers 161 counties within 150 miles of Huntington across Indiana, Kentucky, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, and Virginia.

sources.title: Metro Rate - Marshall University
sources.quote: Starting Fall 2027, Metro tuition covers every county within 150 miles of Huntington. That is 161 counties across Indiana, Kentucky, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee and Virginia.
